result.caveats: This COD-PS dataset has no records for the Abyei region, which is included in the COD-AB layers.  Thus the COD-AB administrative level 1 layer (and the attached gazetteer) has 19 features while this layer has 18; and the level 2 layer (and gazetteer) has 189 features while this dataset has 188.
result.name: cod-ps-sdn
result.notes:
Sudan population statistics disaggregated by administrative levels (0-2), sex and age, projected for the year 2025. The dataset also includes historical data.

The data is split into multiple files: one excel for all administrative levels, individual csv for individual administrative levels, and explanatory notes as .pdf. 

Reference year: 2025

These tables are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Sudan - Subnational Administrative Divisions](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-sdn) at levels 0-2 using the ADM0, ADM1, and ADM2_PCODE fields.
